en.headline: Government to trial electronic proxy voting for estate meetings next year
en.dek: Alice Mak said the platform would help overcome practical difficulties with a cap on proxy votes after consultation showed mixed views on the proposal.
body: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said on Saturday the government would launch a trial of an electronic platform for proxy voting at owners’ corporation meetings by the end of next year.

Mak told a radio programme the trial would cover different types of buildings, including large estates and single-block buildings, as part of proposed amendments to the Building Management Ordinance. The changes follow the Tai Po fire and aim to strengthen safeguards against bid-rigging in maintenance projects.

She said more than half of the written submissions from the public consultation had raised practical difficulties with an immediate numerical cap on the number of proxy votes one person could hold, such as how to determine which votes exceeded the limit once forms were submitted together. The government has therefore decided against an immediate cap and will instead strengthen verification requirements, requiring both the owner and the representative to sign and declare knowledge of the meeting agenda.

Mak added that the electronic system could later help enforce a limit automatically by preventing further authorisations once a threshold was reached. She stressed that any online tools would run alongside paper processes so that older owners would not be disadvantaged.

zh.headline: 政府明年底前試行電子授權票平台 助克服上限操作困難
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，公眾諮詢顯示授權票設上限有實際困難，將透過電子平台先導計劃解決，並加強核實機制。
body: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟周六表示，政府將於明年年底前推出電子平台先導計劃，試行以電子方式處理業主大會的授權票。
麥美娟在電台節目指出，先導計劃會涵蓋大型屋苑及單幢樓宇等不同類型樓宇，屬《建築物管理條例》修訂建議的一部分。修例旨在加強對維修工程圍標的防範，回應大埔火災後暴露的樓宇管理漏洞。
她說，公眾諮詢收到的書面意見中，超過一半反映即時為授權票設數量上限有實際操作困難，例如當多份授權票一併交到管理處後，難以分辨哪些超出上限。因此政府決定暫不設硬性上限，改為加強核實，要求授權人及獲授權人雙方簽署並聲明知悉會議議程。
麥美娟補充，電子平台日後可自動限制授權數量，當達到上限後便無法再按授權。她強調任何網上工具都會與紙本程序並行，以免對較年長的業主造成不便。
